en.pageTitle: Codex Resets — Reset news, announcements & history
en.description: Keep up with Tibo’s Codex reset news: upcoming resets, rollout updates, original announcements and history.
en.headline: Catch the next reset.
en.intro: Follow Tibo’s announcements, rollouts and compensation updates.
en.empty: No entries of this type in the current archive.
en.autoText: A reset applied to eligible accounts. Read the announcement for scope.
en.bankText: A reset credit to use later. Check your account for eligibility and expiration.
en.methodText: This tracker reads Tibo’s public posts directly from X and stores its own records. Replies and quoted posts retain their source relationships. Automatic categories are provisional; a target time passing never proves a reset completed.
en.footer: Independent fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Tibo.
en.privacy: No accounts, no tracking cookies. External links follow their own privacy policies.
en.feedDescription: Codex reset announcements collected directly from Tibo on X.
en.noUpcoming: No pending announcement in the collected records.
en.notGuarantee: The collected history is incomplete; this is not a claim that there are no upcoming resets.
en.overdue: The announced time has passed; completion has not been confirmed.
en.watchNote: An uncertain signal in the source text, not a confirmed commitment.
en.liveNote: Refresh retrieves the latest stored records. It does not trigger a new X API request.
en.stale: Updates delayed. Showing the last available data; current reset status may have changed.
en.offline: Unable to refresh. Showing the last available data.
en.provenance: Original public posts from @thsottiaux on X.
en.note: Independent tracker. Account eligibility and remaining usage must be checked in your own account.
en.feedNote: RSS contains the messages currently collected. It will not be live until automatic collection is connected.
en.collectorBlocked: Automatic collection is not connected. These posts were checked directly on X; this is not a live feed.
en.partial: Selected posts verified directly on X. The historical archive is not complete.
en.pendingNote: An announcement remains pending until a linked update confirms progress.
en.statsNote: These are message counts, not counts of distinct reset events.
en.lastConfirmed: Time since the last confirmed reset
en.noAnnouncementNote: We’ll update this when Tibo posts
en.notifyNote: Email, Telegram, Webhook, browser alerts and RSS.
en.notifyOnNote: This browser will alert you when a new reset update appears.
en.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. You can still use RSS.
en.notifyUnsupportedNote: This browser does not support notifications. Use RSS instead.
en.notificationCenterIntro: Choose how you want to hear about new signals, announcements, rollouts and confirmed resets.
en.channelBrowserDesc: A quick alert while this site is open.
en.channelEmailDesc: Works in the background. Confirm the link we send you.
en.emailPending: Check your inbox and confirm the subscription.
en.channelTelegramDesc: Connect the Codex Resets bot for instant messages.
en.channelWebhookDesc: For your own tools. The endpoint must echo the verification challenge as JSON.
en.webhookSaved: Webhook connected. Save this signing secret:
en.channelRssDesc: Use any feed reader. No account required.
en.notifyPrivacy: Email addresses and delivery settings are used only for reset alerts. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.
en.notifyError: Could not save this alert. Check the details and try again.
en.notifyRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
en.calendarIntro: Hover for the reset note; select a marked day to open the X post
en.xStreamIntro: Every public post captured since tracking began
en.archiveMood: A small trail of confirmed reset days
en.communityText: Tap once, let it go, and get back to building. The counter starts fresh after each confirmed reset.
en.onePerIp: One anonymous wish per network each reset cycle

zh.pageTitle: Codex Resets — 重置动态、预告与历史消息
zh.description: 及时掌握 Tibo 的 Codex 重置动态：重置预告、发放进展、原始公告与历史消息。
zh.headline: 不错过下一次重置。
zh.intro: 跟进 Tibo 的预告、发放进展与补发消息。
zh.empty: 当前档案还没有收录此类型的公告。
zh.autoText: 面向适用账号直接执行的额度重置，具体范围请查看公告。
zh.bankText: 可以稍后使用的备用重置机会，资格和有效期请以账号内说明为准。
zh.methodText: 本站直接读取 Tibo 的 X 公开消息并独立保存记录，保留回复和引用的上下文关系。自动分类仅作初步整理，不会因预计时间已过就认定重置完成。
zh.footer: 独立爱好者项目，与 OpenAI 或 Tibo 无隶属关系，也未获其背书。
zh.privacy: 无需注册，不使用追踪 Cookie。外部链接适用各自的隐私政策。
zh.feedDescription: 直接从 Tibo 的 X 原帖采集的 Codex 重置消息。
zh.noUpcoming: 当前收录的记录中，没有待执行的预告。
zh.notGuarantee: 收录范围尚不完整，不能据此判断接下来没有重置。
zh.overdue: 公告预计时间已过，尚未收到执行完成的确认。
zh.watch: 可能的重置信号 · 未确认
zh.watchNote: 原文中的不确定信号，不代表已确认的承诺。
zh.liveNote: 刷新读取本站最新保存的消息，不会触发新的 X API 请求。
zh.stale: 消息同步已延迟，当前显示上次数据，重置动态可能已变化。
zh.offline: 暂时无法刷新，保留上次获取的消息。
zh.provenance: 消息直接来自 @thsottiaux 在 X 发布的公开原帖。
zh.note: 独立消息追踪站。账号资格与剩余额度请在自己的账号中核对。
zh.feedNote: RSS 提供当前已收录消息，自动采集接通前不会持续更新。
zh.noEvents: 尚未获得独立采集的消息。
zh.collectorBlocked: 自动采集尚未接通。以下消息已直接核对 X 原帖，目前不是实时消息流。
zh.latestNews: 最近已核对的重置动态
zh.partial: 当前为直接核对 X 原帖的精选消息，历史档案尚未补齐。
zh.pendingNote: 预告只有在相关后续消息明确确认时，才更新为已执行。
zh.ruleLabel: 自动初步分类，请核对原文
zh.statsNote: 统计的是消息数量，不是独立重置事件次数。
zh.noAnnouncementNote: Tibo 发布消息后会在这里更新
zh.confirmedAverage: 仅按确认完成的重置计算
zh.notifyNote: 支持邮件、Telegram、Webhook、浏览器提醒和 RSS。
zh.notifyOnNote: 出现新的重置动态时，这个浏览器会提醒你。
zh.notifyDenied: 浏览器已禁止通知，你仍可使用 RSS 订阅。
zh.notifyUnsupportedNote: 当前浏览器不支持通知，请使用 RSS 订阅。
zh.notificationCenterIntro: 出现新的信号、明确预告、发放进展或完成确认时，用你选择的方式提醒。
zh.channelBrowserDesc: 打开本站时，快速弹出一条提醒。
zh.channelEmailDesc: 可在后台接收。我们会先发送一封确认邮件。
zh.emailPending: 确认邮件已发送，请到收件箱完成确认。
zh.emailInvalid: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。
zh.channelTelegramDesc: 连接 Codex Resets 机器人，即时接收消息。
zh.channelWebhookDesc: 适合接入自己的工具；端点需以 JSON 原样返回验证 challenge。
zh.webhookSaved: Webhook 已连接，请保存签名密钥：
zh.channelRssDesc: 任意阅读器都能订阅，无需账号。
zh.notifyPrivacy: 邮箱和投递设置仅用于重置提醒；每封邮件都带有取消订阅链接。
zh.notifyError: 提醒设置没有保存，请检查后重试。
zh.notifyRateLimited: 操作太频繁，请稍后再试。
zh.calendarIntro: 悬停查看重置消息；点击标记日期直达 X 原帖
zh.xStreamIntro: 展示接通采集后捕获到的每一条公开 X 文
zh.archiveMood: 把每一次确认完成的重置，留成一串小小足迹
zh.metricBasis: 按确认完成的记录计算
zh.communityText: 点一下，把期待留在这里，然后轻松回去继续创造。每次确认重置后，计数会重新开始。
zh.onePerIp: 每个网络在一个重置周期内匿名计数一次
